evidence_quotes.O: This remote helps to improve picture quality and allows me to utilize longer shutter speeds without distortion due to camera movement.
evidence_quotes.C: Battery life is good (even with that I strongly recommend at least one back up battery)
evidence_quotes.E: It has now been three years and I am still in love with this remote. So much so that I have since bought two other Logitech Universal remotes!!!
evidence_quotes.A: I've already got my non-tech oriented husband set up to view the cameras using his android phone
evidence_quotes.N: My one gripe is that the menu to get to 'spoken words' is a little but awkward but once I figured it out no further problems.
